title: Communities, Tequio and Self-Government in Oaxaca
goal: Describe how Oaxacan communities decide and work together using passive se and impersonal se.

items: I can say what is done in a community, without saying who does it, with *se*.
I can explain what an assembly, a cargo and tequio are.
I can say that Oaxaca's municipalities choose their authorities in different ways.
